summary: i-80 Gold Corp., a mining company, engages in the exploration and advancement of gold and silver mineral deposits in the United States. It also explores for polymetallic deposits. Nevada. i-80 Gold Corp. was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Reno, Nevada.
